xmldoc.short_description: Restrict a class to scalar instances.

param_input_item.param_description: an object of a class deriving from nelson.mixin.Scalar.

description.p: Derive from nelson.mixin.Scalar to declare that a class can only have scalar instances. Concatenating instances of the class into a non-scalar array, with [a b] or [a; b], raises an error with identifier Nelson:class:concatenationScalar.
Use this mixin for objects that represent a single entity and for which an array of objects has no meaning.

example_item.example_item_data: classdef Config < nelson.mixin.Scalar properties Name = '' end end % a = [Config(), Config()] % errors: objects can only be scalar
